proposal.description: Outstanding strikes are shown solid while the converter is switching (the retry soft-start and the clean-run window) and blink only during the hiccup off-time, because the designer read 'working through a problem' as the hiccup itself
proposal.reason: With strike_level non-zero and no latch, Red_LED1 stays lit solid through S_SS and the whole clean-run part of S_RUN instead of following blink. From the front panel this looks the same as a latched trip, although the board is recovering.
